feedback_interpretation: Recent feedback showed that predicted interval width is not calibrated uncertainty and that V1 and V2 can fail independently. Several high-width candidates had accurate or overpredicted finishes, while severe late-family rows continued to show graph-specific behavior. The corrected batch therefore emphasizes local condition and loading contrasts together with compact controls, without imposing a universal correction.
batch_rationale: The 32 labels cover the common compact region, high-ratio controls, intermediate ratio points, low and high loading, ordinary esters and ketones, halogenated aromatics, phenolic structures, and multifunctional late-tail candidates. Same-molecule comparisons for m57, m72, m74, m78, and m149 provide local response information, while m159 and other heteroatom-rich candidates probe structure-specific failure regions. Compact anchors constrain global bias and help the retrained model distinguish frequent ordinary rows from the less frequent broad-finish tail.
